description:
Shelter areas for Complex emergency, Mali, 31 July 2012 (CE20120731MLI): 52 features merged from 3 source layers. Polygon layers with shelter or camp columns, or whose names mention camps, shelters, IDPs, or settlements. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Goudoubou Refugee Camp, Seno Province, Burkina Faso](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-goudoubou-refugee-camp-seno-province-burkina-faso-january-14-2016)
- [Geodata of Mbera Refugee Camp, Bassikounou, South-Eastern Mauritania](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-mbera-refugee-camp-bassikounou-south-eastern-mauritania-december-10-2015)
- [Geodata of Mentao Refugee camp in Soum District, Sahel Province, Burkina Faso](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-mentao-refugee-camp-in-soum-district-sahel-province-burkina-faso-january-15-2016)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Staduim; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT 6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Komsat-2; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `Sensor_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_Date
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Confidence_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `Confidence_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Field_Validation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `Field_Validation_label`.

table:columns.name: CampStatusID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Closed / Relocated; 1 = Open (Operational); 2 = Planned / Under Construction; 9 = Camp Destroyed. The decoded text is in `CampStatusID_label`.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: CampType
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Refugee Camp; 2 = IDP Camp. The decoded text is in `CampType_label`.

table:columns.name: FormaltentID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Yes; 2 = No. The decoded text is in `FormaltentID_label`.

table:columns.name: CampStatID_L2
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 10 = Open - New; 20 = Open - Reopened; 30 = Open - Expanded; 40 = Open - Contracted; 50 = Open - No Change; 60 = Open - Unknown (clouded / no coverage); 70 = Closed - New (no further indication of resident status); 80 = Closed - Relocated / Aggregated to adjacent camp site; 90 = Closed - Absorbed (site absorbed by other camp expansion); 100 = Closed - Unchanged; 110 = Planned (opening within next days, grounds prepared); 120 = Planned (grounds not prepared, opening date undefined). The decoded text is in `CampStatID_L2_label`.

table:columns.name: Date_Opened_OLD
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Before 2009; 2 = Before 30 March 2011; 3 = Before 15 April 2011; 4 = Between 30 March - 15 April 2011; 5 = Between 15 April -28 July 2011; 6 = Between 28 July / 18 Aug 2011; 7 = Between 28 July - 21 August 2011; 8 = Between 18 -21 August 2011; 9 = Before 31 October 2010; 10 = Between 21 August - 4 Sept. 2011; 20 = Before 1 April 2011; 21 = Between 1 April - 12 September 2011; 22 = Between 21 August - 18 October 2011; 23 = Between 12 Sept. -18 October 2011; 30 = Between 21 August - 12 September 2011; 40 = Between 12 September - 18 October 2011; 41 = Between 18 October 2011 - 16 January 2012; 42 = Between 18 October 2011 - 2 May 2012; 43 = Between 18 October 2011 - 10 May 2012; 44 = Between 14 September 2011 - 10 May 2012. The decoded text is in `Date_Opened_OLD_label`.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: CampStatID_L2_label
table:columns.description: `CampStatID_L2` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: CampStatusID_label
table:columns.description: `CampStatusID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: CampType_label
table:columns.description: `CampType` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Confidence_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Confidence_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Date_Opened_OLD_label
table:columns.description: `Date_Opened_OLD` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Field_Validation_label
table:columns.description: `Field_Validation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FormaltentID_label
table:columns.description: `FormaltentID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Sensor_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
